description: This line plot illustrates the BLEU score across different epochs for three data categories: Regular members, Members with near-duplicates, and Held-out data. The x-axis is labeled "Epochs" and features a linear scale with tick marks ranging from 0.5 to 3.0 at regular intervals of 0.5. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU score" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.35, with tick marks spaced every 0.05. The plot contains three solid lines without markers. The dark blue line, representing "Regular members," begins at approximately 0.02 at 0.2 epochs and exhibits a gradual, steady increase with minor fluctuations, ending at approximately 0.07 at 3.0 epochs. The orange line, representing "Members with near-duplicates," starts at approximately 0.025 at 0.2 epochs and shows a steep upward trend, reaching 0.34 at 2.0 epochs, dipping slightly to 0.33 at roughly 2.2 epochs, and ultimately peaking at approximately 0.365 at the end of the x-axis at 3.0 epochs. The dark green line, representing "Held-out data," begins at approximately 0.025 at 0.2 epochs, rises slightly to 0.04 at 0.5 epochs, and then maintains a relatively flat trend with minor fluctuations, concluding at approximately 0.03 at 3.0 epochs.
